description: The Australian Ocean Data Network catalogue publishes Sentinel-1 synthetic-aperture-radar measurements of directional ocean swell spectra, spectral partitions and summary wave properties around Australasia. The cited DOI identifies a June 2022 snapshot; the same provider lists ongoing delayed-mode and near-real-time streams. Its own page states delayed daily NetCDF files from July 2015 through March 2022 and near-real-time files grouped every six hours. It states CC BY 4.0 and public access without a fee. These along-track observations can validate coastal wave, harbour-exposure and maritime-operability simulations. They do not replace nearshore wave gauges or resolve every coastal inlet. Wave retrieval is less complete for some sea states, and overlap with satellite tracks makes spatial sampling uneven. Users should distinguish the preserved DOI snapshot from the changing live streams. It complements data-ihdata-ihcantabria-wave-hindcasts, which is a simulated wave product. No data file or sample notebook was downloaded.
